convert_lumina_checkpoint_to_diffusers: convert a Lumina checkpoint to diffusers format by remapping state dict keys and saving the model
run_lumina_conversion_script: run the conversion script with --origin_ckpt_path and --dump_path to convert a Lumina checkpoint to diffusers
save_lumina_transformer_only: save only the LuminaNextDiT2DModel transformer by passing --only_transformer True to the conversion script
build_full_lumina_pipeline: build a full LuminaPipeline with VAE, text encoder, tokenizer, and scheduler by passing --only_transformer False
review_state_dict_remapping: review the state dict key remapping logic that converts Lumina checkpoint keys to diffusers LuminaNextDiT2DModel keys
